title: A peanut bar, a bag of popcorn and Percy Spencer: the slower truth about the microwave oven

posts.facebook:
The story says a chocolate bar melted in a radar engineer's pocket. The truth is slower, and more interesting.

How a self-taught engineer who sped up wartime radar production turned stray microwaves into a way to cook, why the famous melted-chocolate story is probably too neat, and how long it took for the oven to reach the kitchen.

Lucky accidents tend to happen to people who are already paying attention and know what they are looking at.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/curious/percy-spencer-microwave-oven/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
